name: Ineptitude + Chemicals = Fun
summary: Lomac Gearstrip sends volatile NG-5 to Gaxim Rustfizzle in the Stonetalon Mountains. Gaxim needs the chemical to ignite several wagons packed with dynamite, creating a distraction for Alliance operations in the disputed crags.

sections.title: A Volatile Delivery
sections.body: Lomac Gearstrip hands over Nitromirglyceronium, or NG-5, an unstable compound born of gnomish engineering. He warns you to handle it with extreme care. Mishandled, the chemical could blow you to pieces on the road back to Gaxim Rustfizzle.

sections.title: A Recipe for Distraction
sections.body: Once Gaxim Rustfizzle receives the canister intact, he explains what he intends to do with it. NG-5 can ignite entire wagons packed with dynamite. Gaxim plans a great explosion to sow chaos and draw enemies away in Stonetalon while the Alliance pursues its goals in the region.

faq.answer: NG-5, short for Nitromirglyceronium, is a highly volatile chemical compound made by Lomac Gearstrip. It is needed to ignite heavy explosives.
Gaxim Rustfizzle is a gnome mage in the Stonetalon Mountains. He directs Alliance demolition efforts and uses explosions to distract regional threats.
Lomac Gearstrip is an engineer and associate of Gaxim Rustfizzle. He prepares the dangerous NG-5 compound and hands it over to couriers.

faq.q: Why does Gaxim need so much explosive power?
faq.answer: Gaxim has arranged several wagons packed with dynamite. NG-5 can ignite them in a single blast, creating a powerful diversion.

faq.q: Is the chemical dangerous to transport?
faq.answer: Yes. Lomac warns that NG-5 is unstable and could detonate if mishandled. Handle it carefully on the way to Gaxim.

faq.q: Where does this delivery take place?
faq.answer: The delivery ends at Gaxim Rustfizzle's post in the passes of the Stonetalon Mountains.

angles.text: Gnomish ambition puts Nitromirglyceronium to work igniting wagons of explosives as a distraction.
Handling NG-5 calls for care with volatile chemicals to avoid an early detonation.
Stonetalon is contested, and a massive explosion gives Alliance operatives room to pursue their goals.
